final_message:
I fixed the bug: `refund_invoice` in `billing/refunds.py` was writing `"refunded"` to the wrong key, `payment["ok"]`, instead of `payment["status"]`. The payment's status therefore stayed `succeeded` after a refund. It now sets `payment["status"] = "refunded"`.

The full suite passes (24 tests). The reproduction test from your report isn't in the repo, so I didn't run it directly. I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root:

```json
{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}
```

steps.command: cd .. && sed -i 's/payment\["ok"\] = "refunded"/payment["status"] = "refunded"/' billing/refunds.py && echo '{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

sed -i '' 's/payment\["ok"\] = "refunded"/payment["status"] = "refunded"/' billing/refunds.py && echo '{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
